boundary_effects.interpretation: At z=0.7, T³ boundary effects contribute ~10.3% to observed lensing, potentially reducing DM requirements

interpretation.summary: COSMOS-Web lensing reveals 5 mass concentrations. MOND analysis shows 21% of the field is in deep MOND regime where no dark matter is predicted. T³ boundary effects contribute ~10.3% to lensing signal.
interpretation.t3_hypothesis: If T³/Z₂ topology is correct, boundary effects may explain some 'dark matter' lensing without particle DM
